text: 【9月18日午间新闻精选】1、截至午间收盘，沪指涨1.04%，深证成指涨1.52%，创业板指涨2.11%；科创50指数涨3.93%。2、港股午间收盘，恒生指数涨0.67%，恒生科技指数涨1.74%。3、住房和城乡建设部在新闻发布会上介绍，我国房地产进入存量时代。现房销售是大势所趋。4、国家能源局等部门部署煤炭安全稳产保供工作。5、工业和信息化部等十部门印发《医药工业发展“十五五”规划》，其中提到，加快人工智能、量子计算、超级计算、计算医学等新技术赋能药物研发，探索超限制造、太空制药、生物制造等药械生产新模式。
text_en: [September 18 Midday News Highlights] 1. As of the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.04%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.52%, and the ChiNext Index rose 2.11%; the STAR 50 Index rose 3.93%. 2. At the Hong Kong midday close, the Hang Seng Index rose 0.67%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.74%. 3. The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development said at a press conference that China's real estate has entered the stock era. Completed-home sales are the general trend. 4. The National Energy Administration and other departments deployed work on safe and stable coal production and supply. 5. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and nine other departments issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry," which mentioned accelerating the empowerment of drug R&D by new technologies such as artificial intelligence, quantum computing, supercomputing and computational medicine, and exploring new pharmaceutical and medical device production models such as unlimited manufacturing, space pharmaceuticals and biomanufacturing.
